result.scope: Local Studio client while server directs the regular avatar walk; not a mobile or multiplayer benchmark
limitations: RenderStepped intervals are not CPU utilization.
Memory is the process total reported by Stats, not a house-only allocation.
Named Stats timings are retained as raw API values; no unverified unit conversion is applied.
Observed Studio quality, viewport, background apps and sampling overhead influence results.

units.ProcessMemoryMb: megabytes as reported by the OS for the current game session/process
units.RenderCPUFrameTime: raw Stats timing value; docs identify render CPU frame workload but omit the unit
units.RenderGPUFrameTime: raw Stats timing value; docs identify render GPU frame workload but omit the unit
units.PhysicsStepTime: raw Stats timing value; docs describe physics update duration but omit the unit

interpretation.note: result.passed means the bounded sampler completed and collected enough render events; it is not a universal performance pass or 60 FPS guarantee.
interpretation.measuredMovement: 10 of 60 metric intervals recorded more than 0.1 stud avatar travel; sample includes movement and stationary periods.
interpretation.noBaseline: No matched empty-house/device baseline was collected; process memory and frame cost cannot be attributed exclusively to this asset.
interpretation.persistentEdits: None. No Script instances, player movement, camera edits, quality changes, or Studio mode changes.

samplerSource:
local RS=game:GetService("RunService")
local Stats=game:GetService("Stats")
local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
assert(game.PlaceId==121672571539226 and RS:IsRunning() and RS:IsClient(),"Expected Aero Play Client")
assert(not _G.AeroPerfQA or _G.AeroPerfQA.done,"Sampler already running")
local character=player.Character
local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
assert(root,"Avatar not ready")
local metricNames={"FrameTime","RenderCPUFrameTime","RenderGPUFrameTime","SceneDrawcallCount","SceneTriangleCount","InstanceCount","PhysicsStepTime"}
local samples={}
for _,name in ipairs(metricNames) do samples[name]={} end
samples.ProcessMemoryMb={}
local intervals={}
local out={done=false,placeId=game.PlaceId,context="Play Client",durationRequestedSeconds=30,scope="Local Studio client while server directs the regular avatar walk; not a mobile or multiplayer benchmark",metrics={},metricErrors={},movement={samples=0,movingSamples=0,pathDistanceStuds=0},limitations={"RenderStepped intervals are not CPU utilization.","Memory is the process total reported by Stats, not a house-only allocation.","Named Stats timings are retained as raw API values; no unverified unit conversion is applied.","Observed Studio quality, viewport, background apps and sampling overhead influence results."}}
_G.AeroPerfQA=out
local started=os.clock()
local previousPosition=root.Position
out.startPosition={root.Position.X,root.Position.Y,root.Position.Z}
local renderConnection,resetConnection
local cancelled=false
local lastMetrics=-math.huge
local function sampleMetrics()
 for _,name in ipairs(metricNames) do
  local ok,value=pcall(function() return Stats[name] end)
  if ok and type(value)=="number" and value==value then table.insert(samples[name],value)
  elseif not out.metricErrors[name] then out.metricErrors[name]=tostring(value) end
 end
 local ok,value=pcall(function() return Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)
 if ok and type(value)=="number" and value==value then table.insert(samples.ProcessMemoryMb,value)
 elseif not out.metricErrors.ProcessMemoryMb then out.metricErrors.ProcessMemoryMb=tostring(value) end
 if root.Parent then
  local distance=(root.Position-previousPosition).Magnitude
  out.movement.samples+=1
  if distance>.1 then out.movement.movingSamples+=1 end
  out.movement.pathDistanceStuds+=distance
  previousPosition=root.Position
 end
end
local function summary(values)
 if #values==0 then return {samples=0} end
 table.sort(values)
 local total=0
 for _,v in ipairs(values) do total+=v end
 return {samples=#values,min=values[1],max=values[#values],mean=total/#values,p50=values[math.max(1,math.ceil(#values*.5))],p95=values[math.max(1,math.ceil(#values*.95))],p99=values[math.max(1,math.ceil(#values*.99))]}
end
task.spawn(function()
 local ok,problem=xpcall(function()
  renderConnection=RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
   if dt>0 and #intervals<15000 then intervals[#intervals+1]=dt end
   if os.clock()-lastMetrics>=.5 then lastMetrics=os.clock();sampleMetrics() end
  end)
  resetConnection=player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(c) if c==character then cancelled=true end end)
  repeat
   task.wait(.1)
   assert(not cancelled and player.Character==character and root.Parent,"Character reset during sample")
  until os.clock()-started>=30
 end,debug.traceback)
 if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect() end
 if resetConnection then resetConnection:Disconnect() end
 sampleMetrics()
 out.seconds=os.clock()-started
 out.renderIntervalSeconds=summary(intervals)
 if out.renderIntervalSeconds.mean then out.averageRenderEventsPerSecond=1/out.renderIntervalSeconds.mean end
 for name,values in pairs(samples) do out.metrics[name]=summary(values) end
 out.finalPosition=root.Parent and {root.Position.X,root.Position.Y,root.Position.Z} or {}
 out.connectionsDisconnected=2
 out.passed=ok and #intervals>=100
 if not ok then out.error=tostring(problem) end
 out.done=true
end)
return HS:JSONEncode({started=true,duration=30,context="Play Client"})
